TITLE: Template
CREDIT: Strobe interpretation of <what the artwork is>
DESCRIPTION: <What it shows, then what moves, then what the music does, in plain sentences.> Procedural, no reference media.

CONTROLS.NAME: speed
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Overall pace of everything that moves. At zero the scene holds still.

CONTROLS.NAME: spin
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How fast the wheel turns. At zero it holds still.

CONTROLS.NAME: wobble
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How unsteady the hand is. At zero every line is ruler-straight.

CONTROLS.NAME: glow
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: The halo the paint throws onto the panel. At zero there is none.

CONTROLS.NAME: reactivity
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How strongly the music moves everything. At zero the scene ignores it.
